title: Malicious code in novalithtts (PyPI)
description: The PyPI package 'novalithtts' version 0.1.0 is part of a malicious campaign falsely advertising itself as an 'audio-analysis profiles' loader. Instead of providing legitimate functionality, it downloads and executes remote malicious scripts, likely continuing a coin-mining campaign. There is no embedded URL in the package, indicating remote code execution is triggered externally. This package poses a direct threat by executing unauthorized code on affected systems.
aiSummary: The 'novalithtts' package on PyPI, specifically version 0.1.0, is identified as malicious software masquerading as an audio-analysis tool. Its actual purpose is to download and execute remote malicious scripts, enabling remote code execution. This behavior aligns with a known coin-mining campaign (2026-10-voxeval) that used similar tactics and wording. The package does not embed the malicious URL internally, suggesting dynamic retrieval of the payload. This constitutes a supply chain threat through a malicious package upload.
aiImpact: Systems that install or run the 'novalithtts' package version 0.1.0 may execute remote malicious code, potentially leading to unauthorized system control, resource abuse (such as cryptocurrency mining), or further compromise. The malicious code execution can undermine system integrity and confidentiality. No known exploits in the wild have been reported yet.
